other_conditions: Must have passed class 10th from any recognized school in Jharkhand or possess a local residence certificate of Jharkhand
Must meet the exam's eligibility criteria for coaching under this scheme
Class 11th students are eligible for exams that require Class 12th qualification
Cannot have received similar benefits from another department (no dual benefits)
Benefit can be availed only once under this scheme
Student must secure at least 75% attendance for the entire coaching period
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹2,500 and free coaching at reputed institutes.
